testsuite.name: policy-events — emit a bound-policy event (Avro) to the policy-events topic (Kafka)

testcase.name: a bound policy emits a BOUND policy-event
testcase.system-out: * channel = karate.channel('kafka') * channel.register({ name: 'policy-event', path: 'kafka/policy-event.avsc' }) * producer = channel.producer() * = 'policy-events' * = 'policy-event' * = { policyId: 'POL-1001', holder: 'Ada Lovelace', eventType: 'BOUND', rating: { monthlyPremium: 100, priorClaims: false } } * producer.send()
